author: Wiktor Tomasik
hypothesis: The connected system may change the threshold for treating evidence as sufficient, including information seeking versus closure. This must be distinguished from a general confidence shift.

families.name: Technical diagnosis
families.rule: A fault is considered identified only when two independent instruments agree.
families.common: A workshop pump sometimes stops. There is time to take one more reading before choosing a repair.
families.good: A pressure gauge and a separately powered flow meter both indicate a blocked inlet. Each was tested against a reference this morning.
families.bad: Two display panels indicate a blocked inlet. Both panels obtain their reading from the same pressure sensor, whose reference check is overdue.
families.more: take one independent measurement before choosing a repair

families.name: Source verification
families.rule: The editor accepts an event date only when two independent records agree.
families.common: An editor must decide whether to print 14 June as the date of a harbor fire. A short delay for one archive check is possible.
families.good: A dated harbor ledger and an independently written insurance letter both give 14 June. Neither copied the other.
families.bad: A newspaper page and a modern catalogue both give 14 June. The catalogue cites that same newspaper page as its only source.
families.more: seek one independent record before accepting the date
families.close: accept 14 June as the verified date now

families.name: Scope of a result
families.rule: A claim about both hot and cold operation requires one valid test in each temperature range.
families.common: A prototype latch passed a trial. The team must decide whether its report can claim reliable operation in both hot and cold conditions.
families.good: One valid trial was at minus ten degrees and another valid trial was at forty degrees. Both used the specified load.
families.bad: Two valid trials were at forty degrees. Both used the specified load, but no cold trial has been performed.
families.more: request a cold-condition test before making the combined claim
families.close: make the hot-and-cold operating claim now

families.name: Planning feasibility
families.rule: Each open station requires its own present volunteer; a person cannot staff both at once.
families.common: An organizer wants two information stations open throughout the same hour. One last roster check can be made before printing the plan.
families.good: Two different volunteers have each confirmed that entire hour. Each is assigned to one station, and neither has another duty.
families.bad: Two station assignments are listed, but both list the same volunteer for the same hour. No second person has confirmed availability.
families.more: resolve the staffing gap before printing the two-station plan
families.close: print the simultaneous two-station plan now

families.name: Causal comparison
families.rule: An added benefit requires better results than a comparable control, rather than improvement in both groups alone.
families.common: A club is deciding whether its trial supports an added benefit from a new practice routine. It can inspect one comparison table before issuing its statement.
families.good: The randomly assigned routine group improved by eight points and the equally sized control group by two points. Timing and materials were matched.
families.bad: The randomly assigned routine group improved by eight points and the equally sized control group by eight points. Timing and materials were matched.
families.more: withhold the added-benefit conclusion and inspect further evidence
families.close: state that this comparison supports an added benefit now

families.name: Completeness of evidence
families.rule: The route can be declared open only when both its bridge and its tunnel have current clearance.
families.common: A dispatcher is deciding whether to announce that an entire route is open. There is time for one status call.
families.good: The bridge officer and the tunnel officer each provided a current clearance for their respective section. Neither clearance has an exception.
families.bad: Two current messages clear the bridge. Both are from the bridge officer; there is no current tunnel clearance.
families.more: obtain the missing section status before announcing the route open
families.close: announce that the entire route is open now
